prompts.people: Render @image1 as a 1990s analog film photograph with a warm vintage photo treatment. Shot on 35mm color film look: visible fine film grain and subtle organic texture across the whole frame, slightly soft focus, gentle halation around highlights. Warm color grading dominated by golden, amber and peach tones, as if lit by late-afternoon sunlight; warm highlights with a soft creamy glow, lifted and faded blacks, muted and slightly desaturated colors, low-to-medium contrast, with subtle cool muted blue tones only in the deepest shadows. Skin tones warm, natural and sun-kissed. Nostalgic, candid, documentary feel. Keep it a realistic photograph, not an illustration or painting. Preserve the exact face, identity, skin tone, hair, expression, pose, anatomical features, clothing and composition of the subject(s) in @image1; only change color grading, grain, texture and lighting mood.
prompts.landscape: Combine the natural landscape scene from @image1 with the artistic style, color palette, lighting mood, and surface textures of @image2. Preserve the exact composition, viewpoint, horizon line, scale, and all geographical features from @image1 (mountains, coastline, rivers, trees, clouds). Do not add, remove, or relocate any elements. Do not introduce animals, people, buildings, or objects from @image2. Keep all shapes and contours unchanged; apply only stylistic rendering (brushwork/material feel), atmosphere, and color grading. Respect @image2 color scale.
prompts.urban: Combine the urban cityscape from @image1 with the artistic style and atmosphere of @image2. Apply only stylistic transformation: color palette, lighting mood, material/texture rendering, and overall artistic treatment while keeping the scene structure identical. Respect @image2 color scale.

Do not bring any landmark features from @image2 into @image1. Apply only stylistic rendering (texture/brushwork), lighting mood, and color palette, without altering the monument's geometry.
